title: Code and data for: Generative operators in language-model ensembles: what they add to their starting point and what they cost
description: Code, derived data (parsed final answers as letters, numbers or opaque codes, 0/1 correctness, token counts and costs) and tests that recompute the tables of the paper "Generative operators in language-model ensembles: what they add to their starting point and what they cost" (paper 2 of a series on language-model ensembles) from the stored data, offline and without model calls: self-consistency, sources of diversity, debate, synthesis and decomposition, measured against their starting point and compared at an equal budget in dollars; an exploratory set A and a preregistered confirmatory set B. Code under MIT; per-source terms for the data in LICENSE-DATA.md. GPQA Diamond and HLE: item identifiers and answer letters or opaque codes only.
